Name: Fumo Fumo - Touhou Plushies
Author: kittnet
Description:
A bunch of Touhou plushies, from the mainline games until DDC and a few extras, added as extra furniture pieces. 

[img]https://files.catbox.moe/4vpl5g.png[/img] Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]; please make sure you install it first!
[img]https://files.catbox.moe/n3eak4.png[/img] Currently, you will need to use something like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url] to get them in-game.
[img]https://files.catbox.moe/4vpl5g.png[/img] You can disable which game packs are available in-game - use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to do so.

I may add more at some point. I hope you enjoy!
